title: Remove confirmed dead code: SdfSamplingJob and GroupedPartSiblingOrderer
description:
## Summary
Two confirmed dead declarations remain in the runtime/editor assemblies. `SdfSamplingJob` (`Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Morphology/Sdf/SdfProgram.cs:329`) has zero callers — superseded by `SdfSamplingRowBatchJob` — but is also the correct global-index scratch reference pattern, so it must be kept until `TSK-0212` lands. `GroupedPartSiblingOrderer` (`Assets/Scripts/Editor/PartSiblingOrderer.cs:45`, static `Grouped` at `:68`) has no code path that can select it and no external references.

## User Mandate
> "Synthesize the latest unreviewed audits and re-review the other recent audits from the last 2 days or so in order to extract all relevant information into the task system, or to improve the agent/skills/process/development pipeline aspects"

STRICT. Do not narrow or re-scope this requirement; surface any proposed change first.

## Scope
- Delete `GroupedPartSiblingOrderer` and its `Grouped` property, or wire a real selection path if the grouped strategy is still intended (state which).
- After `TSK-0212` lands, delete `SdfSamplingJob`.
- Do not change behavior of the live row-batch sampler or the selected sibling ordering.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `grep` finds no references to either symbol; whole-project build is 0 warnings / 0 errors.
- Existing SDF sampling and sibling-ordering tests stay green.

## Validation
Whole-project compile gate; focused runtime tests for SDF sampling and editor tests for part sibling order.

## Findings
`docs/audits/audit-race-followup-and-streamlining-2026-09-11.md` confirmed zero callers for `SdfSamplingJob` and an unreachable `GroupedPartSiblingOrderer`. Verified by grep at synthesis time (2026-09-11): `IDnaSerializer` has 0 references (`TSK-0126` is already Done), `SdfSamplingJob` appears only at its own declaration, `GroupedPartSiblingOrderer` only at its declaration plus the static `Grouped` property.

## Blockers
`SdfSamplingJob` deletion is gated on `TSK-0212` landing (it is the working reference for correct scratch offsets).

## Next Step
Delete `GroupedPartSiblingOrderer` now; delete `SdfSamplingJob` once `TSK-0212` is fixed and verified.
